Name: EMRSSI -- Even More Realistic Seasonal Shop Inventory
Author: StunkyMcDoo123
Description:
--- Even More Realistic Seasonal Shop Inventory ---

EMRSSI is a collection of small patches to further expand RSSI to other mods. This adds randomized and limited shop stocks to the patched mods for a more challenging gameplay. 

Inspired by the work of Boringvlln and JohMarley2018, patches are now available for the following mods

--- Stardew Valley Expanded Forage Crops -- Zoeyhoshi
--- PolyamorySweet, [b][color=#00ff00]Complete[/color][/b]

PLANNED MODS (not in specific order)

-- Ridgeside Forage Crops -- Zoeyhoshi
-- Dwarven Expansion
-- Stardew Valley Expanded Forage Crops and Bushes -- Zoeyhoshi
-- The Melting Pot
-- Grapes of Ferngill
-- Stardew Vineyard
-- Cult of the Lamb
-- Others that I feel like doing.
